crossRefs.note: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four…
Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to…
Therefore Saul said to Yahweh, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people…
Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both…
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.”…
They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

people.name: Matthias
people.line: Apostle chosen to replace Judas Iscariot.

translations.web: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
translations.bsb: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias. So he was added to the eleven apostles.
translations.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
translations.asv: And they gave lots for them; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
